# Elizabeth Shin writes for The Korea Economic Daily


October 5, 2026


-
-
-
-


In an article for *The Korea Economic Daily* ,[Elizabeth Shin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/elizabeth-shin/) explains how Korean businesses can use legal finance to manage the cost and risk of commercial disputes while preserving capital for core business priorities. She explores how legal finance can support more strategic capital allocation and help legal teams unlock the value of litigation assets.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.hankyung.com/article/202610031577i)
